description: Declarative folder ACLs provisioned at install/upgrade via install-collection Step 5.5 (permission-change-helper, admin Accepts). Mirrors the setup bootstrap grant set so upgrades can verify/re-apply idempotently. IMPORTANT (2.0.0 upgrade ordering): the instances/ writer grant must not be applied to an org upgrading from 1.x until the admin has completed the gated-instance review in upgrade/1-to-2.md — 1.x instances may carry per-instance gating that this uniform grant would expose.

grants.purpose: Members can walk the collection tree (templates, indexes).
Universal visibility floor: every member writes pointer records for the clients they create (both tiers).
Org-public tier commons: uniform member access to org-public client instances. UPGRADE GATE: see description — gated-instance review first on 1.x upgrades.

notes: Admin grants on templates/ and config/ are per-member (bootstrap_admins + add-admin/remove-admin), not group-declarative — they stay in the setup bootstrap and admin tasks. Private-tier client folders live in members' own My Drives and are never provisioned here.
